changelog: mariowOS 1.5.0 makes mariowOS feel like a real OS. Windows keys work inside mariowOS (Win opens Start, Win+L locks, Win+D shows the desktop, Win+arrows snap windows, Win+Ctrl+arrows switch virtual desktops, Win+V clipboard history, Win+. emoji, Win+Shift+S screenshot). Live wallpapers (MP4, WebM, GIF), a dynamic island for music, timers and updates, a Pomodoro timer, daylight gradient and parallax. New Guest account, parental controls with blocked apps and allowed hours, personal backup and restore, and Switch user on the lock screen. System health page in Settings. The Store shows app permissions, stars and what is new, and can update apps by itself.
